notes.title: NEKOPARA 18+ DLC Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7308193/04d90867c5b39b6abd2a32a6e56d995133359711.png[/img]
In case you haven't noticed, the NEKOPARA - 18+ Adult Only Content DLC will be coming to Steam on December 17th! These DLCs are exactly the same as the versions on Denpasoft/DLSite/NEKOWORKs booth. There is no difference between the versions, they all contain the same content and are with mosaic. We hope you all are looking forward to the releases! Please note you must own the base game on Steam to purchase these DLCs.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/947650/NEKOPARA_Vol1__18_Adult_Only_Content/]NEKOPARA Vol.1 - 18+ Adult Only Content[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/947660/NEKOPARA_Vol2__18_Adult_Only_Content/]NEKOPARA Vol.2 - 18+ Adult Only Content[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/947670/NEKOPARA_Vol3__18_Adult_Only_Content/]NEKOPARA Vol.3 - 18+ Adult Only Content[/url]

We also wanted to mention that we're also bringing even more to Steam! Please look forward to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/990830/ReLord_1__18_Adult_Only_Content/]Re;Lord 1 - 18+ Adult Only Content DLC[/url]! This DLC is the exact same version as the one on our website (with mosaic). 

We're also bringing two [b]fully uncensored[/b] visual novels to Steam as well! Yes, that means no mosaics on these next two titles! 
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/979330/Hikari_Clover_Rescue/]Hikari! Clover Rescue[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/942850/I_Walk_Among_Zombies/]I Walk Among Zombies[/url]  
*Please note we're still working on updating I Walk Among Zombies on our site to contain no mosaic. If you already own the Denpasoft version please keep an eye out for an updated download link once it's ready! 

[b]By the way, one last announcement![/b] Chapter 02 of the NEKOPARA digital Manga is now live on Amazon! Make sure to grab it and enjoy these adorable cat girls now in manga form!

[url= https://www.amazon.com/dp/B07HVS1BH6/ ]NEKOPARA Chapter 01: Here Come Chocola and Vanilla! Kindle Edition[/url]
[url= https://www.amazon.com/dp/B07L2WF92B]NEKOPARA Chapter 02: The Bells Kindle Edition[/url]


To stay up to date on our releases please make sure you're following our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Denpasoft]Publisher Page[/url] on Steam! You can also follow [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/nekoworks]NEKO WORKs[/url] on Steam as well!

notes.title: NEKOPARA Vol. 1 Update
notes.content:
NEKOPARA Vol.1 has been updated to address an issue where clicking EXTRA in the title menu may cause the game to crash.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.
